title: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 8-K Filing
summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, disclosing a registered direct offering of common stock and concurrent private placement of warrants, raising approximately $5.0 million in gross proceeds. H.C. Wainwright acted as placement agent. Net proceeds are intended to support commercialization of LYMPHIR™ and general corporate purposes.
key_points: Citius Pharmaceuticals issued 4,730,457 shares at $0.985 per share plus pre-funded warrants for 345,686 shares at $0.9849
Concurrent private placement included Common Warrants to purchase up to 5,076,143 shares at $0.86 exercise price, exercisable immediately with 5-year term
Gross proceeds of approximately $5.0 million, net proceeds approximately $4.5 million after fees
Placement agent fee of 7.0% of gross proceeds plus Placement Agent Warrants to purchase 355,330 shares at $1.2313
Company imposed 45-day lockup on additional issuances per Purchase Agreement
Beneficial Ownership Limitation set at 4.99% (upgradable to 9.99% with 61 days notice)
